 Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Oct 27, 2026, 06:02 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Tommy Paul and Paige Lorenze (Getty Images) Earlier this year, tennis star Tommy Paul and his wife, Paige Lorenze, made a major move towards building their future together. The couple listed their separate homes for a combined $5.29 million after discovering a property they believe could become their forever home. With millions of dollars tied up in real estate, the listings reveal how their priorities are changing as they prepare for marriage and consider starting a family. Their decision also puts two very different luxury properties on the market, each offering buyers a distinct lifestyle. Tommy Paul and Paige Lorenze list homes worth $5.29 million
 Paul, 28, has listed his modern Boca Raton mansion in Florida for $2.8 million. The tennis player purchased the property in 2023 for $2.5 million, meaning he could make a $300,000 profit if it sells at the asking price, before taxes and expenses. His five-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home offers more than 3,000 square feet of living space on a 0.23-acre plot. Built in 2023, the property features a gourmet kitchen, a detached guesthouse and a resort-style pool and spa. Large sliding doors bring natural light into the home and connect its indoor spaces with the outdoor area. Lorenze, meanwhile, listed her Connecticut property for $2.49 million, slightly above the $2.4 million she paid in 2024. The 5,000-square-foot house sits on 2.14 acres and includes four bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, a gourmet kitchen, a swimming pool and several living spaces. Its location, about 60 miles from Manhattan, makes it suitable as both a weekend retreat and a full-time residence. Both listings could deliver a profit, although the final returns will depend on the sale prices and transaction costs. Paige Lorenze reveals why Tommy Paul’s new home changed their plans
 The listings appear closely tied to the couple's search for a shared home. Lorenze explained in a December YouTube video that she had not planned to move until she found a property that matched their future ambitions. “I was actually not looking to move,” she revealed in December. “[But I] stumbled upon this listing and it had everything that I could ever imagine.” Join conversation

 She described the property as her “dream forever home” after visiting it with Paul soon after Thanksgiving. Privacy, more land and room for their interests helped convince them that the move made sense. “More privacy is really important to me, more land is important to me, and this property has so many of the things that Tommy and I love.” The new property reportedly includes a tennis court, a large barn, a guesthouse and enough space for Lorenze's horses. It would also give Paul a place to train between tournaments. The couple began dating in 2022 and announced their engagement in July 2025 after Paul proposed during a getaway in Nantucket. They plan to move into the new home in February, while Paul continues his demanding tennis schedule and Lorenze prepares to join him in Australia for the Australian Open.
